Folders created during atomic writes, their creation stages, and crash-left empty folders
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): each write creates only the folders of its own address, outermost first, before its temporary file; a folder left by a crash is used as it stands.

dispositions.topic_text: Recovery and same-call continuation when a crash leaves lock-parent folders without a lock file
dispositions.reason: A partly created lock (folders without the file) is completed by the next use and is execution of A6 rule 4, carried to State 7 in round-44 T2; no other history is admitted.
